$comment: New schemas for Platform → Engine & capacity and AI accounts (src/domain/platformEngine.ts). Additive: apply expand-first on every tenant BEFORE deploying the engine worker or the functions. Until then the worker leaves them alone (its catalog has no such schema: no heartbeat rows, no account rows; lanes still lease from the pool when MF_AI_ACCOUNTS_DIR is set) and platform.engine.status / platform.ai.accounts.list answer empty lists. Writers: the engine worker only (service identity: heartbeat.ts, aiAccountSync.ts); platform.ai.accounts.save updates Status, Priority and Note; the rotation threshold is the PlatformSetting engine.rotateAtPercent (default 99). Policies: policies.json (read super admin + service, write service). Indexes: indexes.json. Validations: validations.json. No credentials are ever stored in these schemas.

fields.name: HostId
fields.description: The engine worker's id (EngineJob.ClaimedBy of its jobs); one row per host, written by its heartbeat every 30 s (server/blocks/engineWorker/heartbeat.ts).

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The host name (letters, digits, dot, dash only).

fields.name: LastSeenAt
fields.description: ISO time of the last heartbeat; older than 2 minutes = the worker stopped reporting.

fields.name: CpuPercent
fields.description: CPU busy share since the previous heartbeat (/proc/stat deltas), 0..100.

fields.name: Load1
fields.description: 1-minute load average.

fields.name: Load5
fields.description: 5-minute load average.

fields.name: Load15
fields.description: 15-minute load average.

fields.name: CpuCount
fields.description: Logical CPUs.

fields.name: MemUsedMb
fields.description: Memory in use (MemTotal - MemAvailable), MB.

fields.name: MemTotalMb
fields.description: Memory in total, MB.

fields.name: DiskUsedGb
fields.description: Used space of the file system holding the engine's project folders, GB.

fields.name: DiskTotalGb
fields.description: Size of that file system, GB.

fields.name: RunningJobs
fields.description: Engine jobs this worker runs now.

fields.name: RunningLanes
fields.description: Official MADP lanes (child processes) running now.

fields.name: ActiveAgents
fields.description: Claude Code agent processes under those lanes now.

fields.name: QueueLength
fields.description: Queued engine jobs the worker sees.

fields.name: Release
fields.description: The engine release the worker runs (release id, or checkout).

fields.name: Uptime
fields.description: Seconds the host has been up.

fields.name: RequestKey
fields.description: Idempotency key, set by the engine worker (engine-host:<HostId>, engine-sample:<HostId>:<minute>, ai-account:<HostId>:<Label>); unique index.

fields.name: HostId
fields.description: EngineHost.HostId of the host.

fields.name: At
fields.description: ISO time of the sample (one per minute; kept 7 days, older ones are deleted by the worker).

fields.name: CpuPercent
fields.description: CPU busy share, 0..100.

fields.name: MemUsedMb
fields.description: Memory in use, MB.

fields.name: RunningJobs
fields.description: Engine jobs running.

fields.name: ActiveAgents
fields.description: Claude Code agents running.

fields.name: RequestKey
fields.description: Idempotency key, set by the engine worker (engine-host:<HostId>, engine-sample:<HostId>:<minute>, ai-account:<HostId>:<Label>); unique index.

fields.name: Label
fields.description: The account's name on the engine host (its folder under MF_AI_ACCOUNTS_DIR, or api-key). Never a credential, an e-mail address or a path.

fields.name: Provider
fields.description: claude-subscription | anthropic-api.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: active (in rotation) | standby (only when no active account can) | cooling (the engine rests it until ResetsAt) | disabled (never used). People set active, standby or disabled; the engine sets cooling.

fields.name: Usage5hPercent
fields.description: Share of the 5-hour window used, 0..100, as the engine last measured it; -1 = not measured yet.

fields.name: Usage7dPercent
fields.description: Share of the 7-day window used, 0..100; -1 = not measured yet.

fields.name: ResetsAt
fields.description: ISO time the binding window resets (or the rest ends); empty when unknown.

fields.name: LastUsedAt
fields.description: ISO time a lane last started or ended on the account.

fields.name: Priority
fields.description: Order among accounts with equal headroom: lower first (default 100).

fields.name: Note
fields.description: People's note (plain text, no credentials).

fields.name: HostId
fields.description: The engine host the account lives on (EngineHost.HostId).

fields.name: OnHost
fields.description: False when the account's folder is no longer on the host (the row is kept).

fields.name: RequestKey
fields.description: Idempotency key, set by the engine worker (engine-host:<HostId>, engine-sample:<HostId>:<minute>, ai-account:<HostId>:<Label>); unique index.
